main_title: The Flight of the Condor and the Eagle
main_sub: God is ONE: human existence transcends matter and space-time
header_desc: The Gnostic gospels, written nearly two thousand years ago, hold the key to one of the greatest enigmas of modern physics: quantum gravity, symbolizing the ultimate union between science and spirituality: The demiurgic ego possesses mass and creates the illusory tempo-material; to counter it, the universe offers us a Universal Consciousness, timeless and acausal: the ONE, whose guidance —followed with the heart— allows us to ignite the divine spark.
left_title: The Return of Sophia: From the Prison of Yaldabaoth to the Kingdom of Light
left_body: In general relativity, matter tells space-time how to curve and space-time tells matter how to move. Similarly, the ego has mass and exerts its own gravity: its density deforms your inner fabric and weaves the temporal and material illusion of the psyche 🧠. Thus, only through the wisdom of Sophia is it possible to understand that the saying ``the Father and I are one'' is a call to dissolve the ``false self'' to return to the Kingdom of pure light where the Invisible Father resides: the timeless and divine reality of the pneuma ❤️.
universe_light_text: Understanding that death is not an absolute end, but a transformation frees us from ignorance. In the right hemisphere, our pneuma resides in the timeless and divine plane, the dimension of high frequency | 999⟩. There lies the land of union and freedom (The Greater Homeland).
center_text: The Pistis Sophia and the demiurge Yaldabaoth: Consciousness manifests through two fundamental states: the spiritual |ONE⟩ ❤️ and the material |EGO⟩ 🧠. This grants us a free will of perception that can be mathematically formalized as an inner product ⟨ONE|EGO⟩.
universe_mat_text: The human body is composed of carbon-12 (6p^+, 6e^-, 6n^0). In the left hemisphere lies the temporal and material plane, the dimension of low frequency | 666⟩. The gravitational force pulls us to a place where: <q>war is peace, freedom is slavery, and ignorance is strength</q> (1984).
final_quote: The prison ┻ in which you sleep 🧠 has its doors open. You just need to turn the map ✝️ to wake up ❤️
p2_sub: Condor and Eagle: The Flight of Science and Spirituality
cap1_title: Chapter 1: The Prophecy of the Condor and the Eagle footnotesize color{golddark}(00:10 -- 01:07)
cap1_desc: Premise and integration framework: the reconciliation between the intuitive wisdom of the South (the heart, ancestral knowledge, and spirit) and the technological development of the North (reason, science, and mind). The call for balance to initiate the evolutionary awakening and transcend the state of duality.
cap2_title: Chapter 2: Quantum Gravity and Temporal Illusion (01:13 -- 02:42)
cap2_desc: The fundamental clash of theoretical physics: General Relativity versus Quantum Mechanics. Why Newton's and Maxwell's laws do not distinguish between past and future, the breaking of Einstein's simultaneity, and the dissolution of linear time as a neural reconstruction of memory.
cap3_desc: The conceptual assembly Faggin--Segarra: the body as a vehicle operated by a conscious quantum field outside of space-time, where qualia reside. Consciousness does not arise from the brain but precedes it, converging with the First Consciousness and the Intelligent Designer free of time and space.
cap4_desc: The finding of Nag Hammadi (1945) and the Coptic codices: the material cosmos conceived not as a home, but as the confinement of the soul. The teaching of the Gospel of Thomas (Logion 3): Jesus did not come to found a religion of dogmas, but to free the inner spark from the prison of the Demiurge through remembrance (gnosis).
cap5_title: Chapter 5: The Kingdom of Light and The Prison of the Demiurge (08:43 -- 10:16)
cap5_desc: The demiurge Yaldabaoth —also known as the great architect of matter— is the creator of the sensible world, an egocentric god ignorant of true divinity. On the other hand, Sophia lies captive in the density of matter, awaiting the spark of awakening.
cap6_title: Chapter 6: The Dajjal and the Universal Hemispheres (10:23 -- 14:38)
cap6_desc: Comparative eschatology and perceptual distortion: the figure of the Dajjal and the visual trick of the inverted paradise (the river and the fire). The mechanism of Orwellian doublethink (1984) as a cognitive prison of the ego, against the revolutionary message of Jesus that dismantles the imperial slavery system.
cap7_title: Chapter 7: Reflections on Our Place in the Cosmos (14:40 -- 16:30)
cap7_desc: In the end, the great paradox reduces to this: in the vastness of the cosmos —with its more than two trillion galaxies— it is there that Jesus' phrase resonates most strongly: “The Father and I are one.” Could this have had a hidden message about the deep bond between humanity and the cosmos?
sagan_quote: <q>The idea that God is a white man, larger than normal, with a flaming beard, sitting in heaven and counting the fall of every sparrow, is ridiculous. But if by God one understands the set of physical laws that govern the universe, then such a God clearly exists. However, this God is emotionally unsatisfying... it doesn't make much sense to pray to the law of gravity</q>
